home.metaTitle: MCB UKSW: laboratory research and services for industry
home.metaDescription: UKSW laboratories in Dziekanów Leśny take on industrial commissions: materials testing, metal 3D printing, HPC computing, drone surveys and environmental analysis.
home.title: Science you can commission.
home.lede: The UKSW laboratories in Dziekanów Leśny take on work from industry: from analysing a cracked part to 3D printing a new alloy. {equipment} instruments, {services} services, experts you can name.

home.flagshipLede: Six instruments where a conversation about a commission usually begins. The full list is in the instrument catalogue.
home.quoteLabel: A word from the Rector of UKSW
home.ctaTitle: Describe the problem. We will find the rest.
home.ctaBody: You do not need to know the name of the method or the instrument. Tell us what you want to test or make, and the MCB office will pass your enquiry to the expert for the right service.
